book.title: Frankenstein · Chapter 10 — The Meeting on the Sea of Ice
book.author: Mary Shelley, Frankenstein (1831), Chapter 10

cast.name: Victor
cast.canonical: a lean, slightly hunched young man with untidy dark hair, round glasses, dark shadowed feverish eyes, wearing a stained lab apron
cast.anchor: round glasses, a stained lab apron and dark shadowed eyes

cast.name: the Creature
cast.role: the made being — intelligent, eloquent, desperately lonely, then vengeful
cast.canonical: a very tall gaunt figure, chalk-white skin, bald head with one bold black stitch-seam across the brow, a bolt at the neck, heavy seams on the arms, deep sorrowful hollow eyes, sharp teeth, ragged shirt
cast.anchor: tallest gaunt bald body, a brow stitch-seam, a neck bolt and sorrowful hollow eyes

panels.scene: a lone bespectacled young man in a dark coat standing dwarfed beneath the towering blue icy wall of a vast glacier in an Alpine valley, shattered pines around, awesome silence

teen.narration: VICTOR SEEKS OUT THE SUBLIME GLACIERS ABOVE CHAMOUNIX.

bubbles.text: the icy wall of the glacier overhung me
the solemn silence of this glorious presence-chamber of imperial Nature

panels.scene: the young man resting at peace among grand shapes of snowy peaks, glittering pinnacles and an eagle soaring in cloud, a fleeting serenity on his worn face
panels.composition: wide, the sublime brings brief peace

teen.narration: THE GRANDEUR TRANQUILLISES HIS GRIEF FOR A NIGHT.

bubbles.text: These sublime and magnificent scenes afforded me the greatest consolation that I was capable of receiving
they all gathered round me and bade me be at peace
although they did not remove my grief, they subdued and tranquillised it

panels.scene: the bespectacled young man setting out in pouring rain and thick mist, determined and grim, a mule beside him, mountain summits hidden in cloud

teen.narration: BY MORNING THE GLOOM RETURNS. HE CLIMBS ANYWAY.

bubbles.text: The rain was pouring in torrents, and thick mists hid the summits of the mountains
I resolved to ascend to the summit of Montanvert

panels.scene: the young man climbing a steep winding mountain path strewn with avalanche-broken pines, some snapped and leaning, a terrifically desolate slope

teen.narration: THE PATH UP MONTANVERT IS BLEAK AND BROKEN.

bubbles.text: It is a scene terrifically desolate.
where trees lie broken and strewed on the ground
In a thousand spots the traces of the winter avalanche may be perceived

panels.scene: the young man pausing on a high ridge in the mist, gazing over a valley of curling river-mists, a melancholy contemplative figure

teen.narration: HE BROODS ON THE FRAILTY OF THE HUMAN MIND.

bubbles.text: We rest; a dream has power to poison sleep.
Nought may endure but mutability!

panels.scene: the vast uneven sea of ice stretching like frozen waves riven by deep crevasses, the small figure of the young man descending onto the glacier, sublime and immense

teen.narration: AT NOON HE DESCENDS ONTO THE MER DE GLACE.

bubbles.text: For some time I sat upon the rock that overlooks the sea of ice.
I descended upon the glacier
The surface is very uneven, rising like the waves of a troubled sea

panels.scene: the young man standing small in a recess of rock on the glittering glacier with the vast white dome of Mont Blanc rising in awful majesty above the clouds, a moment of swelling awe
panels.composition: wide, Mont Blanc in awful majesty

teen.narration: MONT BLANC RISES ABOVE — HIS HEART LIFTS.

bubbles.text: above it rose Mont Blanc, in awful majesty
My heart, which was before sorrowful, now swelled with something like joy
gazing on this wonderful and stupendous scene

panels.scene: a huge distant figure of a man bounding across the ice crevasses toward the viewer with superhuman speed and impossible stature, the small bespectacled young man frozen in alarm in the foreground
panels.composition: wide distance shot, the giant approaches

teen.narration: THEN — A SHAPE OF MORE THAN HUMAN SIZE, RUSHING ACROSS THE ICE.

bubbles.text: I suddenly beheld the figure of a man, at some distance, advancing towards me with superhuman speed
He bounded over the crevices in the ice
his stature, also, as he approached, seemed to exceed that of man

panels.scene: close on the bespectacled young man recoiling in rage and horror as he recognises the towering bald hollow-eyed creature with a stitched brow and a neck bolt, its face bespeaking bitter anguish and malignity

teen.narration: IT IS THE WRETCH HE MADE.

bubbles.text: it was the wretch whom I had created
I trembled with rage and horror
his countenance bespoke bitter anguish, combined with disdain and malignity

panels.scene: the bespectacled young man flinging out an arm and shouting in fury at the towering creature on the ice, face twisted with hatred, the giant impassive before him

bubbles.speaker: VICTOR
bubbles.text: Devil... do you dare approach me?

bubbles.speaker: VICTOR
bubbles.text: Begone, vile insect!

bubbles.speaker: VICTOR
bubbles.text: that I may trample you to dust!

panels.scene: close on the towering bald creature with hollow eyes and stitched brow speaking with sorrowful dignity, one great hand raised, anguish and reproach in its ruined face
panels.composition: close, the creature answers with grief

teen.narration: BUT THE CREATURE ANSWERS — ELOQUENT, AND WOUNDED.

bubbles.speaker: CREATURE
bubbles.text: I expected this reception... All men hate the wretched

bubbles.speaker: CREATURE
bubbles.text: how, then, must I be hated, who am miserable beyond all living things!

bubbles.speaker: CREATURE
bubbles.text: Yet you, my creator, detest and spurn me, thy creature

panels.scene: the towering creature standing firm on the ice, addressing the small young man with grave demand, a threat and a bargain in its bearing

teen.narration: IT DEMANDS ITS CREATOR DO HIS DUTY.

bubbles.speaker: CREATURE
bubbles.text: Do your duty towards me, and I will do mine towards you and the rest of mankind

bubbles.speaker: CREATURE
bubbles.text: if you refuse, I will glut the maw of death, until it be satiated with the blood of your remaining friends

panels.scene: a single bespectacled young man lunging forward and being held back at arm's length by one towering gaunt bald hollow-eyed creature on the ice, the creature calm and immovable and far the stronger, one man and one creature only, clear cold daylight

teen.narration: VICTOR ATTACKS — BUT THE CREATURE IS FAR STRONGER.

bubbles.speaker: CREATURE
bubbles.text: Be calm!

bubbles.speaker: CREATURE
bubbles.text: thou hast made me more powerful than thyself; my height is superior to thine, my joints more supple

bubbles.speaker: CREATURE
bubbles.text: I am thy creature, and I will be even mild and docile to my natural lord and king

panels.scene: close on the towering creature's sorrowful hollow-eyed face turned pleading to the heavens, the small young man listening despite himself, snow around

teen.narration: IT PLEADS: IT WAS BORN GOOD, AND MISERY MADE IT CRUEL.

bubbles.speaker: CREATURE
bubbles.text: I ought to be thy Adam, but I am rather the fallen angel

bubbles.speaker: CREATURE
bubbles.text: I was benevolent and good; misery made me a fiend. Make me happy, and I shall again be virtuous.

bubbles.speaker: CREATURE
bubbles.text: Everywhere I see bliss, from which I alone am irrevocably excluded

panels.scene: the towering creature beckoning the young man to follow across the ice toward a distant small hut, the low sun still high over the snowy precipices
panels.composition: medium two-shot, led toward the hut

teen.narration: IT ASKS ONLY THAT ITS TALE BE HEARD.

bubbles.speaker: CREATURE
bubbles.text: Hear my tale; it is long and strange

bubbles.speaker: CREATURE
bubbles.text: come to the hut upon the mountain

bubbles.speaker: CREATURE
bubbles.text: abandon or commiserate me, as you shall judge that I deserve

panels.scene: inside a dim mountain hut, the towering creature seated by a small fire with an air of exultation, the bespectacled young man across from it heavy-hearted, firelight and ice-blue window light
panels.composition: wide interior two-shot, the fireside truce

teen.narration: VICTOR CONSENTS TO LISTEN. THE CREATURE BEGINS ITS TALE.

bubbles.text: I with a heavy heart and depressed spirits
he thus began his tale.
seating myself by the fire which my odious companion had lighted
